title: fix(record-page): an empty field in the synthesized More details section is counted and revealed by Show empty fields
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XS45uS4YmpkyKDUwCT41Tq)_
Fixes #36404

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户在记录页（侧边预览、手机、宽屏左栏）阅读一条记录时：之前空的「备注」这类长文本字段落在「更多详情」分组里会整组消失、不计入「显示 N 个空字段」，现在会被计数，点开后在「更多详情」分组里显示出来。
- 为什么做：记录页「字段区末尾一行显示空字段」的规则此前漏掉了平台自动生成的「更多详情」分组，读者看不到该字段，计数也少一个。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是某个全空的自动分组在展开空字段后多显示一个分组标题；改动只在平台生成的默认记录页上，可直接撤回此提交。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

On an object's default record page the record body's sections come from `deriveRecordDetailSections`: the object's field groups, else the visible fields split into an untitled primary section and a collapsible "More details" section (long text such as `notes` goes there). `record:details` resolves an omitted `hideEmpty` to `true` on every section it is handed, and `DetailSection` then treats an all-empty section as hidden by its author: it draws nothing and reports nothing to the field list's one "Show N empty fields" row (the hide in `DetailSection` is "not the reader's to undo, and is not counted"). No one authors the synthesized sections, so no one can write `false` on them. That is why an empty "More details" section vanished from read mode, its field was missing from the count, and it showed only in edit mode.

The fix is at the producer: every section the split writes (`splitPrimarySecondary` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDetailSections.ts`) now carries `hideEmpty: false`, the value the `record:details` section contract already declares for keeping an all-empty section. On the field list such a section then follows the objectstack#36147 ruling 7066516044 item 4 unchanged: its empty rows fold into the one row at the end of the field area, are counted there, and are drawn in place when the reader shows them. Nothing in `plugin-detail` changes; the rule itself and its remembered per-object choice are untouched.

Files to read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDetailSections.ts`, the `splitPrimarySecondary` hunk: the three `hideEmpty: false` writes and the comment above them.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDetailSections.moreDetailsEmptyReveal-36404.test.tsx`: the pin, drawn through the real `record:details` renderer inside `RecordPageColumns`.
3. `.changeset/36404-more-details-empty-reveal.md`.

## Tests

Added: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDetailSections.moreDetailsEmptyReveal-36404.test.tsx`. It derives the sections the way `RecordDetailView` does, builds the default page with `buildDefaultPageSchema`, and draws it with `RecordPageColumns` (the laid-out page that mounts the field list and its last row) and the real `record:details` renderer:
- an empty `notes` alone in "More details" is counted (phone + notes = 2), and after pressing the row it is drawn under the "More details" heading;
- CONTROL: a filled `notes` draws before any reveal and is not counted.

No existing test was edited.

Reproduction and ablation (one run, before the fix and with the fix removed): with `recordDetailSections.ts` restored to `origin/main` `ad50d611` (marker `hideEmpty: false as const` counted 0 on disk), the pin fails `AssertionError: expected '1' to be '2'` (1 failed, 1 passed); restored to `HEAD` (marker count 3, `git diff HEAD` empty, blob hash equal to the `HEAD` blob) it passes 2/2. `@object-ui/*` resolves to source through the `ui/vitest.config.mts` alias, so no rebuild sits between the edit and the run.

## Acceptance notes

- Scope of the new value: the sections `deriveRecordDetailSections` writes itself, so the untitled primary section, "More details", and, on an object with field groups, the "Other" section of fields no group claims. A record page Studio seeds from these sections (`deriveStudioDetailSections` on an object with no field groups) saves `hideEmpty: false` too, which `RecordDetailsProps` accepts (the `agreement-12442` spec-parse pin stays green). A page an author writes is unchanged.
- Off the field list (a full page whose details are its only face) an all-empty synthesized section now takes the declared `false` path: it is named in the body's closing empty-sections line instead of vanishing.
- Not changed, recorded for the seat: on the same default page a declared field group whose fields are all empty is written as a `{ group }` reference with no `hideEmpty`, so it still disappears in read mode and is not counted by the row. That is the spec's declared renderer default for a section that omits the key; whether the default page should write `false` on those references too is outside this card.
- Two-minute check: open a lead in app-crm with 备注 empty; the field area ends in 「显示 N 个空字段」 with 备注 counted; press it and 备注 appears under 「更多详情」.
